mapper.select: SELECT ca.company_application_id AS companyApplicationId, ca.user_id AS userId, u.email, u.nickname, u.account_status AS accountStatus, ca.company_name AS companyName, ca.business_registration_no AS businessRegistrationNo, ca.manager_name AS managerName, ca.manager_phone AS managerPhone, ca.company_intro AS companyIntro, ca.public_data_company_name AS publicDataCompanyName, ca.status, ca.review_reason AS reviewReason, reviewer.nickname AS reviewedByNickname, ca.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, ca.created_at AS createdAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_application_document cad WHERE cad.company_application_id = ca.company_application_id AND cad.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS documentCount, ( SELECT MAX(cad.uploaded_at) FROM company_application_document cad WHERE cad.company_application_id = ca.company_application_id AND cad.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS latestDocumentAt FROM company_application ca JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = ca.user_id LEFT JOIN user_account reviewer ON reviewer.user_id = ca.reviewed_by ORDER BY FIELD(ca.status, 'PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED'), ca.created_at DESC

SELECT ca.company_application_id AS companyApplicationId, ca.user_id AS userId, u.email, u.nickname, u.account_status AS accountStatus, ca.company_name AS companyName, ca.business_registration_no AS businessRegistrationNo, ca.manager_name AS managerName, ca.manager_phone AS managerPhone, ca.company_intro AS companyIntro, ca.public_data_company_name AS publicDataCompanyName, ca.status, ca.review_reason AS reviewReason, ca.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, ca.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, ca.created_at AS createdAt FROM company_application ca JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = ca.user_id WHERE ca.company_application_id = #{applicationId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_application_document ( company_application_id, uploader_user_id, document_type, original_name, stored_path, content_type, size_bytes, status, uploaded_at ) VALUES ( #{companyApplicationId}, #{uploaderUserId}, #{documentType}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, 'ACTIVE', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT cad.document_id AS documentId, cad.company_application_id AS companyApplicationId, cad.uploader_user_id AS uploaderUserId, uploader.nickname AS uploaderNickname, uploader.email AS uploaderEmail, cad.document_type AS documentType, cad.original_name AS originalName, cad.stored_path AS storedPath, cad.content_type AS contentType, cad.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, cad.status, cad.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt, cad.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM company_application_document cad JOIN user_account uploader ON uploader.user_id = cad.uploader_user_id WHERE cad.company_application_id = #{applicationId} AND cad.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY cad.uploaded_at DESC, cad.document_id DESC

SELECT cad.document_id AS documentId, cad.company_application_id AS companyApplicationId, ca.user_id AS companyUserId, ca.company_name AS companyName, ca.business_registration_no AS businessRegistrationNo, cad.uploader_user_id AS uploaderUserId, uploader.nickname AS uploaderNickname, uploader.email AS uploaderEmail, cad.document_type AS documentType, cad.original_name AS originalName, cad.stored_path AS storedPath, cad.content_type AS contentType, cad.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, cad.status, cad.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt, cad.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM company_application_document cad JOIN company_application ca ON ca.company_application_id = cad.company_application_id JOIN user_account uploader ON uploader.user_id = cad.uploader_user_id WHERE cad.document_id = #{documentId}
